name.value: Sandcastle Sea Shoppe & Ice Cream Parlour

description.value: Sandcastle Sea Shoppe is an ice cream and gift shop on White Rock's waterfront Marine Drive, advertising over 50 flavours. It sits at street level on one of the most popular seaside cycling corridors in Metro Vancouver's south end. The dual ice cream and gift shop format is a classic seaside stop that typically draws walkers and cyclists exploring the White Rock promenade.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page linked as the business website returned only a login/block wall with no usable business content, making it effectively a fetch failure for evidence purposes. All conclusions therefore rest on OSM tags alone: amenity=ice_cream, shop=gift, description='50+ Flavours', and a Marine Drive waterfront address in White Rock. No amenity details (bike parking, water, washrooms, etc.) can be confirmed or denied from this data alone.
concerns: Website is a Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/50plusflavours/) which returned only a login/block wall; no business content was retrievable — treat as fetch failure.
No phone number present in OSM or website.
No independent website (only Facebook); contact and amenity confirmation is not possible without in-person or phone verification.
All required criteria and optional amenities are unverifiable from available sources.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is plausibly a good WWC fit — a waterfront ice cream shop on a busy cycling route — but the Facebook page was inaccessible and no required criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) could be verified. Manual field verification or a working website is needed before inclusion.
